historical_record.description: The Longfellow Primary School, a fourteen-classroom school, wood-framed on concrete foundations, with metal-lath plaster walls and a tile roof, was taken over by the Board of Education; designed in the city's Bureau of Architecture, it was built by McSheehy Bros. on a $34,943 general contract.
